name: Golden Egg & Scallion Fried Rice
instructions: Separate the white and green parts of the spring onions and beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wide skillet or wok over high heat. Pour in the eggs, scramble until just set into soft ribbons, and transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, garlic, and spring onion whites. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss in the cold rice, pressing out any clumps with the back of your spatula until every grain is hot and slightly toasted.
Drizzle soy sauce around the hot rim of the pan, return the eggs, fold in the green scallions and black pepper, and serve piping hot.

name: Kitchen-Sink Spinach & Pepper Frittata
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper together with half of the grated cheese.
Warm olive oil in an ovenproof non-stick skillet over medium heat. Sauté the onion and diced red pepper for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the baby spinach and stir for 1 minute until wilted and excess moisture evaporates.
Pour in the egg mixture, scatter the remaining cheese on top, and cook gently for 4 minutes until the edges set.
Finish under a hot grill (broiler) for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed and golden brown. Rest briefly before slicing into wedges.

name: Bubble & Squeak Crispy Potato Hash
instructions: Roughly crush or chop the leftover cooked potatoes in a bowl and season well with salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a heavy frying pan over medium heat and fry the sliced onion and shredded cabbage for 6 minutes until tender and lightly charred.
Tip the potatoes into the pan, fold everything together, and press firmly into an even cake.
Cook undisturbed for 5 to 6 minutes until a deep golden crust forms underneath, then flip in sections to crisp the other side.
Top with fried or poached eggs and serve immediately.

name: Sizzling Leftover Chicken & Pepper Wraps
instructions: Toss sliced chicken, red pepper, onion, garlic, cumin, salt, and olive oil together in a bowl.
Heat a large skillet until smoking hot and sear the chicken and vegetables for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and blistered at the edges.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Pile the sizzling filling into the warm wraps, roll tightly, and slice on the diagonal.

name: 10-Minute Scallion & Garlic Butter Noodles
instructions: Boil the noodles until al dente, reserving a splash of starchy cooking water before draining.
Melt the butter over medium-low heat and gently sizzle the minced garlic and half the spring onions for 2 minutes without burning.
Stir in the soy sauce, toss in the hot noodles and a splash of cooking water, and coat until glossy.
Shower with the remaining fresh green scallions and crown with a crispy fried egg if desired.

name: Smoky Garlic Chickpea & Spinach Skillet
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, patting them dry so they crisp nicely in the pan.
Warm olive oil in a skillet, add sliced garlic and paprika, and cook for 45 seconds until aromatic.
Add the chickpeas and fry for 5 minutes, crushing a few lightly with a spoon to thicken the pan juices.
Fold in the baby spinach by the handful until just wilted, finish with fresh lemon juice and salt, and serve.

name: Creamy Tomato & Chicken Skillet Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, saving half a cup of pasta water.
Sauté diced chicken and onion in olive oil until golden, then stir in the minced garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, simmer for 8 minutes to thicken, and swirl in the cream and spinach.
Toss the drained pasta into the blush sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.

name: Warming Red Lentil & Roasted Carrot Soup
instructions: Sweat the onion and carrots in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until glossy.
Stir in garlic and ground cumin for 30 seconds, then add rinsed red lentils and vegetable stock.
Simmer gently for 18 to 20 minutes until the lentils collapse and the carrots are tender.
Blend half or all of the soup to your preferred texture and brighten with lemon juice before serving.

name: Courgette & Red Pepper Baked Eggs (Shakshuka)
instructions: Cook onion, zucchini, and red pepper in olive oil for 7 minutes until tender.
Add garlic and cumin, pour in the canned tomatoes, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and jammy.
Make 4 wells in the sauce with the back of a spoon and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the pan and cook on low for 5 to 6 minutes until egg whites are set and yolks remain runny.

name: Crispy Black Bean, Pepper & Cheddar Quesadillas
instructions: Lightly mash half the black beans in a bowl so they bind together, then mix in the remaining beans, diced pepper, and spring onions.
Lay tortillas flat, scatter cheese and bean mixture over half of each tortilla, and fold into half-moons.
Crisp in a lightly oiled skillet for 2 to 3 minutes per side until deeply golden and oozing melted cheddar.

name: Silky Ginger & Scallion Rice Porridge
instructions: Combine cooked rice, chicken stock, and ginger matchsticks in a saucepan and bring to a lively simmer.
Cook for 12 minutes, stirring often so the leftover rice breaks down into a velvety porridge.
Add shredded chicken to warm through for 3 minutes, ladle into bowls, and top with soy sauce and scallions.

name: Savory Minced Beef & Garlic Rice Bowl
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a hot skillet, letting it caramelize before breaking it into small crumbles.
Add minced garlic, soy sauce, and sugar, tossing for 2 minutes until glazed and sticky.
Spoon over bowls of hot rice and finish with fried eggs and sliced spring onions.

name: One-Pan Potato, Cauliflower & Spinach Curry
instructions: Soften onion and garlic in oil over medium heat, then bloom the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add cubed potatoes, cauliflower florets, and coconut milk; cover and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Fold in the baby spinach until wilted, season with salt, and serve warm.

name: Golden Tuna, Sweetcorn & Scallion Melt
instructions: Mix drained tuna, sweetcorn, sliced spring onions, mayonnaise, and plenty of black pepper.
Lightly toast the bread slices, pile on the tuna mixture, and blanket with grated cheddar.
Grill (broil) for 3 minutes until bubbling and bronzed.

name: Rustic Tuscan White Bean & Vegetable Stew
instructions: Cook onion, carrots, and celery gently in olive oil for 8 minutes until sweet and soft.
Add garlic, canned tomatoes, cannellini beans, and 250ml of water; simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in torn pieces of leftover bread to thicken the broth naturally and drizzle with extra olive oil.

name: Charred Aubergine & Golden Halloumi Salad
instructions: Pan-roast cubed eggplant in olive oil over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and tender inside.
Sear sliced halloumi in the same pan for 2 minutes per side until blistered.
Toss arugula and fresh tomatoes with lemon juice and olive oil, then pile warm eggplant and halloumi on top.

name: Broccoli, Bacon & Cheddar Crustless Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Crisp chopped bacon with diced onion in a pan, then toss in tiny broccoli florets for 3 minutes.
Whisk eggs, milk, black pepper, and most of the cheddar in a bowl.
Combine everything in a greased baking dish, scatter remaining cheese over the top, and bake for 20 minutes until set.

name: Velvety Sweet Potato, Tomato & Peanut Stew
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in a pot with a splash of oil for 4 minutes.
Add cubed sweet potatoes, canned tomatoes, and vegetable stock; simmer covered for 15 minutes until tender.
Whisk peanut butter with a ladle of hot broth until smooth, stir back into the pot, and wilt in the spinach.

name: Lemon, Garlic Prawn & Courgette Ribbon Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente and reserve 60ml of cooking water.
Sear shrimp and sliced garlic in olive oil and butter for 2 minutes until pink, then toss in zucchini ribbons for 1 minute.
Add drained pasta, lemon zest, lemon juice, and reserved pasta water, tossing vigorously until glossy.

name: 3-Ingredient Ripe Banana & Egg Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash the ripe bananas thoroughly in a bowl, then whisk in the eggs, oats, and cinnamon; let rest 3 minutes so the oats soften.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and spoon in small rounds of batter.
Cook for 2 minutes per side until golden and fluffy.
